Interface ClientConnection

All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIClientConnection, SocketClientConnection
public interface ClientConnection
Abstracts the bidirectional communication channel with a client. Implementations handle the transport-specific details (Socket, RMI, etc.) while ClientHandler works only with this interface.

      void sendMessage(Object message)
      Sends a message to the client. Must be thread-safe: multiple threads (e.g., ViewUpdater broadcasting) may call this concurrently.
      Parameters:
